8194.title: Agent page throttling after controller release
8194.rootCauseOneLine: Agent-owned entries start with background throttling disabled, so the CDP controller restores false on release.
8194.proposedFix: Default all entries to throttled at their shared factory; leave temporary controller overrides unchanged.
8194.caveats: Owner-boundary lifecycle reproduced twice with existing Electron fakes. Packaged macOS CPU/GPU and animation metrics were not measured. An unrelated packaging test lacks a system library on both baseline and repaired trees.
